transit.title: Transit Lab
transit.intro: See how planets are found: TESS measured these stars' brightness, and a box least squares (BLS) search looks for small, regular dips caused by a planet passing in front of its star.
transit.not_analysed: There is no transit analysis for this star yet.

status.found-at-harmonic: found at twice or half the period
status.out-of-range: period too long for this data

transit.light_curve_help: The star's brightness over time, with slow variations removed. Ticks at the bottom mark where each candidate's transits fall.
transit.periodogram_help: How well a repeating dip fits at each trial period. Peaks are signals; dashed lines mark the periods of known planets.
transit.secondary_eclipse: secondary eclipse of {{planet}}: the planet passing behind its star
transit.unknown_signal: no known planet at this period
transit.method_note: Computed {{date}} from TESS 2-minute SPOC light curves (MAST) with the CSharpNumerics.Engines transit pipeline: detrending, BLS period search, transit fit and validation.
